## What and why

## How it was checked

- [ ] `dotnet test MicroEngine.slnx -c Release` passes
- [ ] Behaviour changes have tests; visual or feel changes were checked with scripted captures
- [ ] Documentation updated where the change is visible to users

## Contribution terms

- [ ] I wrote this change, or have the right to submit it, and it contains no code or assets under terms
      incompatible with MicroEngine's licence
- [ ] I have signed the MicroEngine contributor agreement
